_about: Public-domain Marvin R. Vincent (Marvin Richardson Vincent, 1834-1922, Presbyterian, Union Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: Amusement, a Force in Christian Training (Troy, 1867) from Project Gutenberg, and 24 more from Internet Archive scans, among them all four volumes of Word Studies in the New Testament (1887-1900), the ICC Philippians and Philemon (1897), A History of the Textual Criticism of the New Testament (1899) and his sermons. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
